tenderSchedule.title: VIDYARATHI SHIKSHANA SETU EDUCATION BRIDGE FOR STUDENTS - Digital Educational Support Initiative for Minority Students Selection of an agency for development and delivery of digital educational content for Classes VI to XII
tenderSchedule.description: VIDYARATHI SHIKSHANA SETU EDUCATION BRIDGE FOR STUDENTS - Digital Educational Support Initiative for Minority Students Selection of an agency for development and delivery of digital educational content for Classes VI to XII

tenderAddress.blockNumber: Maulana Abul Kalam Aazad Bhavan, No.16 C,Millers Tank Bed Area, Vasanth Nagar, Bangalore-560 052

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All the terms and conditions mentioned under the tender document will be applicable

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall have prior experience in imparting training to a minimum of 3000 students cumulatively in last three years

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder shall submit copies of the relevant Work /Agreements/Memoranda of Understanding (MoUs). & Completion Certificates
Others -- List of the candidates as per appendix D

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Institution should have minimum 20 Teachers/Faculties with a minimum of 5 years of teaching experience in relevant subjects.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- list of faculty members along with Self declaration containing faculties name, address & qualification also with certificate of experience
Others -- The bidder should furnish the list of faculty members as per Appendix C
Others -- PF/PT/TDS/ESI or Offer letter of the faculty also to be uploaded under e- procurement portal

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall possess a pre-existing in-house educational video content library for school education comprising recorded academic lectures, with demonstrable class-wise and subject-wise coverage relevant to school education from Classes 6th to 12th

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Self-Declaration of In-House Content Ownership on bidders letterhead, duly signed by the authorised signatory and Notarized
Others -- Details of the existing video library and copies & logins of the same to be provided for verification
Others -- Annex H- also to be submitted for studio details

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder shall have an operational support school/college (6 to 12 ) in Karnataka

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- Agreement of support & School and college registration copy has to be submitted

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The bidding firm should have its own Online Platform on Android or its own website accessible on windows OS or an App Entire video lectures for each Subject wise, Chapter wise and concept wise should available to access. Online Test series with all the chapter wise test papers should be available in the online platform

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- The bidder should furnish the details of App on android or website details operational on windows OS
Others -- Documents regarding presentation of digital content, Users logged in and Usage report of the Learning portal LMS
Others -- should be uploaded in e-procurement of minimum 10-20 Pages

tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: All the documents sought in the tender document should be uploaded
Audited reports, Balance Sheets and Profit & Loss Accounts
Certificate of Incorporation/Registration certificate under society/Partnership deed, any other registered document
Turnover certificate certified by CA & ITR filed for the last three years

itemList.itemName: Cost for providing all digital educational content learning/teaching videos (for 6th to 12th)
